title: 反相加法器
statement: 图示反相加法器中，u_1 = 1 V，u_2 = 2 V，R1 = 10 kΩ，R2 = 20 kΩ，Rf = 30 kΩ，运放为理想运放。
求反馈电阻中的电流 i_f 和输出电压 u_o。

questions.ask: 若 u_2 改为 4 V，R1 中的电流 i1 会怎样变化？
questions.explain: n 点是虚地，电位始终为 0，所以 i1 = u_1/R1 只取决于 u_1。各路输入互不影响，这正是反相加法器能做“加权求和”的原因。

hints: 反相端 n 是虚地，每一路输入电流都可以单独算。
虚断：流入 n 的各路电流之和全部流经 Rf。
solution: 公式形式：u_o = −(Rf/R1·u_1 + Rf/R2·u_2) = −(3u_1 + 1.5u_2)，各输入按 Rf/Rk 加权后相加再反相。

en.title: Inverting summing amplifier
statement: In the inverting summer, u_1 = 1 V, u_2 = 2 V, R1 = 10 kΩ, R2 = 20 kΩ, Rf = 30 kΩ; the op-amp is ideal.
Find the current i_f in the feedback resistor and the output voltage u_o.

questions.explain: n is a virtual ground: i1 = 1/10k = 0.1 mA, i2 = 2/20k = 0.1 mA; by the virtual open, i_f = i1 + i2 = 0.2 mA.

questions.ask: If u_2 is changed to 4 V, what happens to the current i1 in R1?
questions.explain: Node n is a virtual ground, always at 0 V, so i1 = u_1/R1 depends only on u_1. The inputs don't interact — which is exactly why the circuit computes a weighted sum.

hints: The inverting node n is a virtual ground, so each input current can be computed on its own.
Virtual open: the sum of the currents into n all flows through Rf.
solution: **2. Input currents:** i1 = u_1/R1 = 0.1 mA, i2 = u_2/R2 = 0.1 mA.
**3. KCL at n (virtual open):** i_f = i1 + i2 = **0.2 mA**.
As a formula: u_o = −(Rf/R1·u_1 + Rf/R2·u_2) = −(3v_1 + 1.5v_2): each input is weighted by Rf/Rk, summed and inverted.
